name.zh: 风格化 Fenestella（窗格扇苔藓动物）

description.en: Its distinguishing construction is thin flaring fan formed by a regular open lattice of branches and crossbars; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
description.zh: 以薄外张扇由分枝和横杆构成规则开孔网格为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

sources.title: Bryozoa
sources.supports: Branching, sheet and fenestrate colonial body forms and fossil context.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.use: consulted-only; no source media, mesh or texture incorporated
sources.rights_note: No third-party license grant inferred from consultation.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original stylized teaching concept. Palette, nominal dimensions, pose and simplified counts are artistic. No microscopic genus diagnosis, measured specimen, behavior or coexistence reconstruction.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创风格化教学概念；配色、标称尺寸、姿态及简化数量为美术选择。不声称微观属级鉴别、标本实测、行为或同域共存复原。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
